command: uid="$(id -u)" || exit; pids="$(pgrep -x -u "$uid" opencode)"; status=$?; [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || [ "$status" -eq 1 ] || exit "$status"; for pid in $pids; do kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || continue; args="$(ps -o args= -p "$pid")"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || continue; exit "$status"; fi; set -f; set -- $args; [ "${1##*/}" = opencode ] || continue; case "${2:-}" in serve|web|acp) continue;; esac; kill -USR2 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
